集中整理連結、備註與交接事項，讓專案資訊隨手可查。: Keep links, notes, and handover tasks together. Find project details at a glance.

方便辨識專案、搜尋與安排後續交接。: Make the project easy to identify, find, and hand over.
輸入後按 Enter，或用逗號分隔多位負責人。: Press Enter or separate multiple owners with commas.
輸入後按 Enter，或用逗號分隔標籤。: Press Enter or separate tags with commas.

ProjMemo 目前沒有登入與多使用者權限，請只在本機使用，不要把服務公開到區: ProjMemo currently has no sign-in or multi-user permissions. Use it locally and do not expose the service to your LAN or the internet.
一般 Markdown／PDF 匯出永遠不包含實際密碼。啟用下方選項後，專案頁才: Regular Markdown/PDF exports never include passwords. Enable the option below to add sensitive exports to project pages. You must still unlock the vault and confirm before exporting passwords.
一般匯出不包含實際密碼: Regular exports do not include passwords
一般匯出永遠遮蔽密碼。若確有需要，可在: Regular exports always hide passwords. If needed, use
下載完整 SQLite 備份，或從先前的 ProjMemo 備份還原資料。: Download a complete SQLite backup or restore data from an earlier ProjMemo backup.
不要把生產環境的高權限密碼當一般交接附件傳送；優先使用組織的密碼管理工具與授權交: Avoid sending privileged production passwords as ordinary handover attachments. Prefer your organization's password manager and access-transfer process.
例如：GitHub Actions Secrets / 維運負責人: e.g. GitHub Actions Secrets / operations owner
例如：公司密碼庫的項目名稱: e.g. an item in your organization's password manager
例如：測試資料讀寫，無管理權限: e.g. Test data read/write, no admin access
例如：確認 AWS 權限已移交: e.g. Confirm AWS access has been transferred
保存重要連結、實用備註與交接事項，讓每個專案的關鍵資訊都找得到。: Keep important links, practical notes, and handover tasks together so every project's key details are easy to find.
保管庫已在此瀏覽器解鎖，解鎖滿 15 分鐘或重新啟動 ProjMemo 後會自動: The vault is unlocked in this browser. It locks 15 minutes after unlocking or when ProjMemo restarts.
保管庫已解鎖；15 分鐘後自動鎖定。: Vault unlocked; locks 15 minutes after unlocking.
備份包含專案、URL、備註、交接清單、環境設定、帳號紀錄與加密密碼，不包含主密碼: The backup includes projects, links, notes, handover items, environment settings, account records, and encrypted passwords. It does not include the master password or decryption key.
允許產生含實際密碼的 Markdown／PDF（預設關閉）: Allow Markdown/PDF exports with passwords (off by default)
列出最近 10 份。自動備份儲存在目前 SQLite 資料庫旁的: The 10 most recent backups are listed. They are stored beside the current SQLite database in the
列出權限、部署或服務移交事項，逐項追蹤完成狀態。: List access, deployment, and service handover tasks and track their completion.
加入正式環境、程式碼庫或相關文件，方便快速找到入口。: Add production links, repositories, or documentation for quick access.
匯出所有專案資料與設定: Export all project data and settings
匯出檔將包含實際密碼。只有在接收者與傳送管道都安全時才使用；一般 Markdow: This export includes passwords. Use it only with trusted recipients and a secure transfer method. Regular Markdown/PDF exports still exclude passwords.
只接受完整且相容的 ProjMemo 資料庫: Only complete, compatible ProjMemo databases are accepted
只有實際密碼欄位會加密；SQLite 中的專案、帳號、主機、登入名稱及其他備註仍: Only password fields are encrypted. Project details, accounts, hosts, usernames, and other notes remain ordinary SQLite data. Backups contain ciphertext, but not your master password or decryption key. The original master password is required after restoring.
名稱、目前狀態與相關負責人。: Name, current status, and project owner.
基本資訊能幫你日後快速辨識專案，也會出現在專案匯出文件中。: These details help identify the project and appear in exported documentation.
實際密碼保存在指定位置: Password stored at the specified location
尚未填寫專案說明，可在編輯專案中補充用途與範圍。: No description yet. Edit the project to add its purpose and scope.
尚無還原前自動備份；每次成功開始還原前，系統都會先建立一份。: No pre-restore backups yet. One is created before each restore starts.
已允許敏感匯出；解鎖保管庫後才會顯示含密碼匯出選項。: Sensitive exports are enabled. Unlock the vault to see password export options.
忘記主密碼就無法還原已保存的實際密碼。ProjMemo 不提供密碼重設或後門。: If you forget your master password, saved passwords cannot be recovered. ProjMemo has no password reset or backdoor.
我確認此檔案包含實際密碼，並會安全傳送與清除副本。: I understand this file contains passwords and will transfer it securely and remove copies.
把常用連結、注意事項與交接資訊集中在一起。: Keep frequently used links, cautions, and handover details together.
支援 Markdown、程式碼區塊與表格: Supports Markdown, code blocks, and tables
敏感匯出檔可被轉寄或留存在下載資料夾。只在必要時開啟，完成後建議立即關閉，並安全: Sensitive exports can be forwarded or left in Downloads. Enable them only when needed, turn them off afterward, and transfer and remove copies securely.
整理資料庫、網站測試、主機及第三方服務帳號。只有「實際密碼」欄位會加密；帳號、主: Record database, test website, host, and service accounts. Only the password field is encrypted; account details, hosts, usernames, permissions, and purposes are ordinary SQLite fields. Do not put passwords in other fields. Passwords are excluded from page HTML and regular exports.
新增一段簡短描述，記下這個專案的目的。: Add a short description of this project's purpose.
新增一筆資料庫、測試網站或主機帳號，並註明環境與權限。: Add a database, test website, or host account with its environment and permissions.
更換密碼（留白表示不變）: Change password (leave blank to keep it)
標明設定在哪個環境使用，以及 Secret 的存放位置。: Specify the environment and where secrets are stored.

此設定的用途: What this setting is used for

若要更換密碼，請先解鎖保管庫。: Unlock the vault before changing a password.
解鎖期間，能使用這台電腦與本機 ProjMemo 的人可能查看密碼；請在離開時鎖: While unlocked, anyone using this computer and local ProjMemo may view passwords. Lock the vault when you step away.
記錄容易忘記的設定、踩坑經驗和解決方式。: Record settings, pitfalls, and solutions that are easy to forget.
記錄用途與 Secret 存放位置即可，請勿輸入密碼或 Key 的實際值。: Record the purpose and secret location only. Do not enter password or key values.
設定一次主密碼後，ProjMemo 會用 Argon2id 派生加密金鑰，再以: ProjMemo derives a key from your master password using Argon2id and encrypts passwords with AES-GCM. Choose a long, unique passphrase of at least 16 characters.
試試其他關鍵字或狀態篩選。: Try a different keyword or status filter.
資料夾，不會自動刪除。: folder and are not automatically deleted.
資料庫與測試帳號的實際密碼以主密碼加密保護；主密碼只用來解鎖，不會存入 Proj: Database and test account passwords are encrypted using your master password. ProjMemo does not store the master password.
輸入主密碼以查看或保存實際密碼。連續輸入錯誤過多次時，解鎖會暫停一段時間。: Enter your master password to view or save passwords. Repeated failed attempts temporarily pause unlocking.
這份檔案會包含實際密碼。確定繼續？: This file will contain passwords. Continue?
還原會以備份內容取代目前所有專案資料。系統會先自動保存目前資料，完成後可下載該份: Restoring replaces all current project data. ProjMemo first saves a pre-restore backup that you can download afterward.

還原失敗，已使用還原前備份回復原有資料。: Restore failed. Your original data was recovered from the pre-restore backup.
